notes: Cosmological (BBN + Planck Neff) constraint on ALP-photon coupling g_phi_gamma for keV-GeV masses. The pre-analysis hint of AxionMass is incorrect: the paper's exclusion plot (Fig. 6 right) has g_phi_gamma [1/GeV] on the y-axis vs m_phi, so coupling type is AxionPhoton. Main results are naturally expressed in the m_phi-tau_phi plane; the g_phi_gamma-m_phi plane is a CLOSED excluded region (both very large and very small couplings are allowed, intermediate excluded). Points given trace an approximate lower boundary read off Fig. 6 and are uncertain (not a table). Convert via tau = 64*pi/(m^3 g^2) if needed. Not a DM haloscope, so no local density assumed. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.4, 6))
